description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractModel in the Aws\Api namespace, used as a base class for API shape models within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes properties and methods for managing shape definitions and interfacing with shape maps.

classes.name: AbstractModel
classes.description: An abstract base class used by AWS API shape models, providing common functionality for handling definitions and shape resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a definition array and a shape map.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the shape definition as an array.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Gets a value from the definition array by offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value in the definition array at a specified offset.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a certain offset exists in the definition array.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Unsets a value in the definition array at a specified offset.

methods.name: shapeAt
methods.description: Retrieves the shape at a specific key in the definition, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: shapeFor
methods.description: Creates or resolves a shape object based on a definition array.
